explainTr: Non-defining (tanımlayıcı olmayan) cümlecik, zaten bildiğimiz bir kişi veya şey hakkında ek bilgi verir. Bilgi çıkarılsa da cümle anlamlı kalır ve iki yanında virgül bulunur: Ms. Rivera, who leads the school, is calm. Türkçedeki ara cümle gibi düşün.
Kişi için who, nesne için which, aitlik için whose, yer için where kullanılır: Mr. Brown, whose desk is by the door, ... Burada iki kural var: 'that' kullanılmaz ve who/which hiçbir zaman atılamaz.
Ayrıca 'which' tüm bir cümleye de gönderme yapabilir: He was late, which annoyed the teacher. Özel isimlerden sonra (Mr. Brown, Isparta) bu cümlecik genellikle virgüllüdür.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'müdürümüz, ki okulu 11 yıldır yönetiyor, çok sakindir' gibi ara cümleler kullanırız; sıfat-fiil ekleriyle de kurarız (okulu yöneten müdür). İngilizcede ek bilgi virgül + who/which ile verilir ve 'that' bu yapıda kullanılamaz.

reading.title: Meet the team at Maple Grove
reading.text:
On her second visit to Maple Grove Elementary, Hafsa received a printed welcome guide for new staff. It introduced the people she would work with, and she read every page twice.

The principal, Ms. Rivera, who has led the school for eleven years, is known for her calm voice. She started as a fourth-grade teacher in Ohio, where she also studied school leadership. Her assistant principal, Mr. Patel, whose office is next to the gym, handles student discipline and bus schedules. Parents often say that he answers emails faster than anyone else.

The front office is run by Mr. Brown, who has worked at the school since 2009. He knows every student by name, which impresses new teachers. Next to his desk is a small kitchen, where staff members share coffee and snacks on Fridays. The guide recommended that substitutes stop there to introduce themselves.

The school counselor, Ms. Alvarez, whose office is decorated with children's drawings, helps students who are having a hard time at home or in class. She speaks Spanish and a little Turkish, which she learned from a former neighbor. The school nurse, Mr. Kim, who used to work in a hospital, keeps the allergy lists and the first-aid supplies.

The guide also described the mentor program, which pairs every newcomer with an experienced teacher. Hafsa's mentor would be Ms. Dunn, whose third-grade classroom she had visited in the fall. Ms. Dunn, who retires in two years, has taught more than eight hundred students and still keeps a drawer full of thank-you notes.

At the end of the guide there was a map of the building. The cafeteria, which serves about three hundred lunches a day, is on the first floor, and the library, where students read on soft rugs, is upstairs. Hafsa took a pen and circled the room numbers she wanted to remember. For the first time, the school felt less like a big building and more like a community of people with names, habits, and stories.

writing.promptTr: Okula yeni gelen bir vekil öğretmene hoş geldin notu yaz. Okuldaki üç kişiyi tanıt ve en az üç non-defining cümlecik kullan (who, which, whose, where). 120-180 kelime yaz.
writing.promptEn: Write a welcome note to a new substitute teacher. Introduce three people at your school. Use at least three non-defining relative clauses.
writing.model: Dear new colleague, welcome to Maple Grove Elementary! I would like to introduce a few people who will help you in your first week. Our principal, Ms. Rivera, who has led the school for eleven years, is calm and very approachable. You can find her in the main office, which is next to the entrance. Mr. Brown, whose desk is in the front office, will give you the daily plan and a visitor badge. He knows every student by name, so ask him if you are not sure about a child. Our nurse, Mr. Kim, who used to work in a hospital, keeps the allergy lists. Please read them before you give any snacks. On Wednesdays we eat lunch together in the teachers' lounge, where Mr. Brown often brings soup. I hope you will join us. If you have any questions, please call my room, which is number fourteen. We are happy to have you with us, and I am sure you will enjoy this school.
checklistTr: En az üç non-defining cümlecik var mı?
Her cümlecikte doğru zamiri (who/which/whose/where) seçtin mi?
